details.description: Gemma 4 26B A4B-it is the Mixture-of-Experts, instruction-tuned model in Google DeepMind's open-weight Gemma 4 family, released in 2026 and built from Gemini 3 research. It has 25.2B total parameters but activates only 3.8B per token across 8 of 128 experts plus one shared expert, and handles text and image input to generate text output over a 256K-token context window, per Google's Gemma 4 model card. It supports a configurable thinking mode for step-by-step reasoning and native function calling for agentic workflows, and was pretrained on data spanning 140+ languages with out-of-the-box support for 35+, per Google's model card.
advantages: Scores 82.6% on MMLU Pro and 82.3% on GPQA Diamond, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
Scores 88.3% on AIME 2026 (no tools) math competition problems, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
Scores 77.1% on LiveCodeBench v6 competitive-coding problems, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
Scores 73.8% on MMMU Pro, a multimodal (vision) reasoning benchmark, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
Activates only 3.8B of its 25.2B total parameters per token via a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
Supports native function calling for agentic workflows and a configurable thinking mode for step-by-step reasoning, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
disadvantages: All 25.2B parameters must be loaded into memory even though only 3.8B are active per token, per Google's documentation.
Does not support audio input, unlike the smaller Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, and 12B variants, per Google's Gemma 4 model card.
use_cases: Text generation and conversational chatbot applications
Multimodal question answering and image content analysis
Coding and mathematical problem-solving with step-by-step reasoning
Agentic workflows using native function calling

notes: Benchmark scores were cross-checked between Google's official Gemma 4 model card and the model's own Hugging Face card, both listing identical figures for the 26B A4B row. Catalog's facts (262,144-token input, 32,768-token output, image_input/text_input/text_output modality with no audio_input) are consistent with Google's model card, which lists 256K context and no audio support for this size (audio is only on the smaller E2B/E4B/12B variants).
